definition: The board game Go — a landmark AI challenge cracked by AlphaGo in 2016 and surpassed by self-play systems like AlphaZero.
details: The board game Go — a landmark AI challenge cracked by AlphaGo in 2016 and surpassed by self-play systems like AlphaZero.

explainer.lead: Go is a board game that became a landmark test of whether AI could master a challenge long considered exceptionally difficult. AlphaGo cracked that challenge in 2016, and self-play systems such as AlphaZero later surpassed it.

tiers.eli5: Go is a board game that served as a giant test for computers, like an especially hard puzzle used to see how well they could think. AlphaGo passed that test in 2016. Later, AlphaZero showed that a computer could become even stronger by practising through games against itself.
tiers.practitioner: Go is used as a landmark setting for game-playing AI and self-play research. AlphaGo marks the 2016 breakthrough, while AlphaZero represents the later self-play approach; a common pitfall is treating AlphaGo as the endpoint rather than one stage in that progression.
tiers.paperLevel: Go can be represented as a sequence of states and actions, s0, a0, s1, a1, ..., with a system selecting actions during play. AlphaGo is the named work that cracked this AI challenge in 2016; self-play systems such as AlphaZero subsequently surpassed it.

explainer.example: In 2016, AlphaGo turned Go from an outstanding landmark challenge into a demonstrated AI success. AlphaZero then went further, using self-play to surpass that earlier achievement.

usedIn.name: AlphaZero
usedIn.detail: A self-play system that later surpassed AlphaGo's milestone.

usedIn.name: Game-playing AI research
usedIn.detail: Go provides a landmark challenge for studying and comparing AI systems.

explainer.intuition: Go mattered because success at the game became a symbol of progress on a difficult AI challenge. Its story also shows a shift from AlphaGo's 2016 breakthrough to stronger systems trained through self-play.
howItWorks: Use Go as the challenge an AI system must learn to play.
AlphaGo cracked that landmark challenge in 2016.
Later systems generated playing experience through self-play.
AlphaZero exemplified this approach and surpassed the earlier milestone.
explainer.whyItMatters: Go provides a clear milestone for measuring progress in AI: first AlphaGo's breakthrough in 2016, then the stronger results achieved by self-play systems such as AlphaZero.
misconceptions: Go is the board game, not the name of an AI system.
AlphaGo's 2016 success was a milestone, not the final word on Go-playing AI.
AlphaZero's advance is specifically associated with self-play.
